name: pagebound-pdf-mcp-server
description: Tokenless MCP server exposing Pagebound's PDF operations (info, text extraction, text diff, merge, split, extract/delete/rotate/reorder pages, stamp watermark & page numbers, AES-256 encrypt, AcroForm read/fill, images→PDF) to LLM agents over stdio (local) or Streamable HTTP (hosted). Reuses the same engines as the Pagebound web app: pdf-lib + pdfjs-dist + WebCrypto.
